newsitem.title: USA: Sotheby's stake raised by Bass Group.
newsitem.headline: Sotheby's stake raised by Bass Group.

text.p: A group led by the Bass Family of Fort Worth, Texas, said Thursday it raised its stake in Sotheby's Holdings Inc to 4,732,900 Class A shares or 12.2 percent from 10.3 percent previously held.
In a filing with Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 644,000 shares between March 3 and April 9 at $14.80 to $16.56 a share.
The group holds the stake for investment.
Sotheby's, based in New York, is an auctioneer of fine art, jewelry and decorative art. It is also in the financing and real estate business.
